bukti: This study aimed to use a computer vision method with a cross-line laser beam to measure the volumes of oil palm FFB using a segmentation process and an ellipsoid equation.
Samples were 40 oil palm FFB of Tenera Variety.
catatan: Pengukuran volume tandan lepas panen untuk sortasi pabrik; abstrak tidak menyebut jumlah pandangan per tandan, sehingga multipandang diisi N.

bukti: This paper presents two apple recognition models based on YOLOv8 and Single Shot MultiBox Detector (SSD) algorithms respectively and compares their performance under identical conditions.
Additionally, we derived a formula to estimate apple volume using camera parameters and field-of-view data.
catatan: Evaluasi hanya pada deteksi satu kelas; rumus volume diturunkan tetapi abstrak tidak melaporkan evaluasinya. Apabila teks lengkap mengevaluasi estimasi volume, kode yang lebih tepat adalah C2 atau C5.

bukti: This study evaluated the utilization of combined computer vision and laser-light backscattering imaging in determining the oil content and color changes of oil palm FFB at different maturity levels
The average classification accuracies were also higher than 85% in classifying oil palm FFB maturity.
catatan: Studi laboratorium pada 90 tandan; selain klasifikasi kematangan, kadar minyak juga diprediksi (MUTU dan SENSOR turut cocok sebagai tugas sekunder).
